digest.component_or_area: ticket digest framework and clarity rule validation
propositions: Literal canonical section headings should be narrowed to semantic content and aliases; historical tickets execute valid plans via section-heading variations or compact structured formats without explicit Approach headings

Exact lexicon matchers for placeholders produce false positives on mechanically decidable conditions with fully specified actions; conditional work markers require semantic normalization to distinguish unresolved choice from bounded execution

Behavioral assertion forms in Acceptance Criteria serve as proof oracles without requiring explicit verification-clause sentinels; proof coverage should be recognized as coaching rather than a hard validity gate
Read-only analysis, operational probe, and external-attestation tickets with explicit no-edit output contracts must be exempt from edit-set and file_impact requirements

Conjunction and vagueness patterns in AC serve as advisory signals but cannot deterministically distinguish atomic bundled matrices from independent deliverables; AC hygiene should remain a review prompt rather than a validity criterion

Testing section applicability depends on semantic classification of work type; negative scenario requirements should not trigger on heading presence alone for mechanical or regression-focused work lacking user-facing behavior changes
